problem_statement: When decompressing a 6LoWPAN frame whose compressed-header nesting is excessively deep (e.g. ~41 nested compressed header units), the stack does not reject it: it either completes the decompression or fails for an unrelated resource reason, instead of returning a parse error. Decompression of input whose compressed-header nesting depth exceeds a reasonable bound must be rejected with a parse error, while shallow legitimate nesting (a few levels) must still decompress successfully.
oracle_note: observed by validate_instance.py (fail before, pass after the fix); the unit oracle is per executable, so check attribution of the cases to the PR's change
